final: WITH matched AS (SELECT o.dealedge AS side FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault), side_counts AS (SELECT side, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM matched GROUP BY side), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM side_counts), paired AS (SELECT s.side, s.cnt, a.avg_cnt FROM side_counts s JOIN overall a ON a.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT * FROM paired WHERE cnt > avg_cnt) SELECT SUM(cnt), AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) FROM kept
